mls.text_en: Learn the basics of Apache Lucene full-text search
mls.text_es: Aprende los conceptos básicos de búsqueda de texto completo con Apache Lucene

mls.text_en: Apache Lucene is a high-performance, full-featured text search engine library written in Java. It is suitable for nearly any application that requires full-text search, especially cross-platform applications.
An introduction to vector-based similarity search and its applications
mls.text_fr: Une introduction à la recherche de similitude basée sur les vecteurs et ses applications

mls.text_en: Vector search enables finding similar items based on semantic meaning rather than exact keyword matches. This technology powers recommendation systems and semantic search engines.
Building Search Applications with Spring Boot
A guide to integrating search functionality in Spring Boot applications
mls.text_de: Ein Leitfaden zur Integration von Suchfunktionen in Spring Boot-Anwendungen

mls.text_en: Spring Boot makes it easy to create stand-alone, production-grade Spring-based applications. Integrating search capabilities with Lucene provides powerful full-text search features.
Implementing faceted navigation for improved user experience
mls.text_es: Implementación de navegación facetada para mejorar la experiencia del usuario

mls.text_en: Faceted search allows users to explore a dataset by applying multiple filters based on faceted classification. Each facet corresponds to a property of the documents, enabling drill-down navigation.
Document Type Systems in Enterprise Search
mls.text_en_uk: Document Type Systems in Enterprise Search

mls.text_en: How type systems enable structured search in enterprise environments
mls.text_en_uk: How type systems enable structured search in enterprise environments

mls.text_en: A robust type system defines the structure and semantics of documents, enabling consistent indexing, validation, and search. Type-aware systems can provide field-specific analyzers and specialized search behaviors.
